basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old from Austin, Texas, working as a freelance graphic designer. I have a keen interest in wildlife documentaries and unconventional diets, which explains my frequent visits to subreddits like 'TigerKing' and 'carnivore'. My job allows me flexibility, so I'm usually online during late evenings after my work is done. I'm single and enjoy exploring new hobbies, especially related to food and health.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and have developed a self-taught interest in nutrition and wildlife. My interest in these areas grew from personal health goals and a fascination with animal documentaries.
